blocks.html:
It shall be unlawful in any nonproduction laboratory to:
   1.   Store or use any explosive.
   2.   Store or use any unclassified detonable organic peroxide, detonable pyrophoric material, detonable unstable (reactive) material or detonable water-reactive material.
   3.   Store or use any Class 4 unstable (reactive) material.
   4.   Store or use any Class 4 oxidizing material.
   5.   Store or use any flammable gas below grade.
